arguments.sql:
SELECT quote(t.k_symbol) AS stored_purpose, typeof(t.amount) AS amount_type, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(t.amount) AS amount
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY t.k_symbol, typeof(t.amount)

WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'

  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
LIMIT 1
